{{Quote|What's the matter? Afraid of spiders?|[[Zeelius Kraymunder]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ZK">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Zeelius Kraymunder|Rori}}</ref>}}
'''Hermit spiders''' were dangerous arachnoid creatures living on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|Hermit spiders are solitary creatures|Zeelius Kraymunder, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ZK" />}}
Hermit spiders were large arachnid creatures native to the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="TCSWE" /> that could also be found on its moon [[Rori/Legends|Rori]].<ref name="SWG" /> They were predatory,<ref name="TCSWE" /> aggressive and poisonous spiders.<ref name="Sony">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Star%20Wars%20Galaxies:%20Bestiary%20-%20Naboo|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Bestiary &ndash; Naboo}}</ref> These spiders were solitary creatures,<ref name="SWG:ZK" /> but they had a rigid social structure,<ref name="TCSWE" /> including specialized individuals such as guards and queens.<ref name="SWG" />

Hermit spiders were likely related to [[nightspider]]s, another arachnid species from Naboo.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|It's a simple thing. Just go and kill a hermit spider and come back as the victorious spider-slaying hero. Oh, and remember -- when you got to the mound, there were at least fifty of them, you had to lob a thermal detonator, and the carnage was fantastic.|Zeelius Kraymunder, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ZK" />}}
[[File:Mutanthermitspider-2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Mutant hermit spiders on Naboo]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], mutant strains of hermit spiders, larger in size, were discovered on Naboo.<ref name="Sony" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Zeelius Kraymunder]] convinced [[Jaleela Bindoo]], the organizer of the [[Narmle Arts Gala]] on Rori, that a nest of hermit spiders threatened the upcoming gala. Terrified by spiders, Bindoo accepted to fund Kraymunder to eliminate the creatures. The crook then hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill a hermit spider and collect the carcass. Zeelius Kraymunder later pretended that the spacer killed at least fifty spiders with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] and brought back the dead queen.<ref name="SWG:ZK" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nightspider_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Hermit spiders appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, hermit spiders were virtually identical to [[nightspider]]s but no explicit relationship was established between the two species.<ref name="SWG" />

The hermit spider later had its own entry in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''. The illustration used in the book for the hermit spider was directly taken from the [[Wookieepedia]] article.<ref name="TCSWE" />
